The creature can use the reaction three times, after which this gift goes away. The leprechaun can revoke this gift from une créature at any time (no action required). A creature can benefit from only one leprechaun's Gift of Luck at a time.

entries: When the memory web is reduced to 0touché points, it discharges any memories it consumed over the past 24 heures in a telepathic deluge. Hazy, dreamlike visions of these discharged memories lodge in the minds of creatures up to 120 mètres from the memory web.

entries: Nafas can't leave the Infinite Staircase or be trapped within a container (such as an Iron Flask). Attempts to transport Nafas to another plane are wasted.

entries: When Nafas drops to 0touché points, his body disintegrates into a whirl of multiversal dust that surrounds une créature responsible for his demise. That creature then hears Nafas's last wish: for la créature to take his place.

If la créature accepts, it is transformed into a noble djinni. The creature's game statistics are replaced by those of Nafas (including this trait), though it retains its name, alignment, and personality. The creature also inherits Nafas's palace and all it contains.
If la créature refuses, Nafas gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all histouché points and appearing in a random safe location on the Infinite Staircase.
